''See also: [[Sky's Mercy Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Sky's [[Mercy]] is a [[cloudship]] belonging to the Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch of the [[Arelius family]]. Functioning as a mobile headquarters, it allows the family to conduct business outside of their standard territory. The vessel consists of a large blue cloud with a house situated in its center, featuring several amenities including a bar, a training room, six bedrooms, a washroom, and a chamber for [[cycling]]. The ship is equipped with an internal web of power that provides information regarding the movements and states of those on board. While it can fly through the air, it is capable of landing on the ground to allow [[constructs]] to recharge. Despite its utility, the ship was eventually destroyed, leaving wreckage scattered across a mountainside.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Sky's [[Mercy]] is a vessel mentioned by Naru Cassias Arelius{{!}}Cassias that serves as the personal [[cloudship]] for the Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch of the [[Arelius family]]. Functioning as a flying building or house, this vessel features a reservoir and is equipped with a control board. The interior contains several amenities, including six bedrooms, a washroom, a bar, a training room, and a silent chamber for [[cycling]]. [[Lindon]] and his companions have traveled aboard the ship, utilizing it as a vessel for descent.}}
